content.text:
**Preserve channel defaults and clarify K1+K2 as clearing all step-mask overrides on the selected channel.** That is my recommended contract and the observed implementation; the inspected evidence does not establish that defaults should reset.

- [program.lua:630](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/models/program.lua:630) clears only the six `step_*_masks` tables, including micro-time and chords. Git blame traces that entire implementation to `7eb04291` (2024-10-14), supporting longstanding preservation.
- [README.md:591](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/README.md:591) explicitly defines default inheritance; [README.md:986](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/README.md:986) calls the channel action clearing “all mask trig locks.” The broader “all masks” wording at line 601 is ambiguous, not sufficient evidence of a defect.
- [channel_edit_page_ui.lua:1540](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/pages/channel_edit_page/channel_edit_page_ui.lua:1540) prioritises held steps over K1. Only with no grid keys held does K1+K2 call channel clear. [channel_edit_page_ui_refreshers.lua:43](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/pages/channel_edit_page/channel_edit_page_ui_refreshers.lua:43) displays inherited defaults after overrides disappear.
- [length-mask-hierarchy-validation.json:27](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/docs/testing/length-mask-hierarchy-validation.json:27) records held-step K2 revealing the restored channel length default, while explicitly leaving channel-wide clear and other attributes pending.

Suggested manual wording:

> On the Masks page, hold a step and press K2 to clear its step-mask overrides. With no grid keys held, hold K1 and press K2 to clear all step-mask overrides on the selected channel. Both actions preserve channel mask defaults, which apply wherever an explicit step override is absent. Held steps take precedence even while K1 is down. Other channels are unaffected.

Highest-value real-input regressions:

- Set distinctive nonempty defaults and conflicting step overrides; clear through actual grid/key inputs and verify inherited screen values and MIDI pitch, velocity, duration, trig silence/onset and chord voices.
- Keep a second channel populated with different defaults and overrides; verify its values and playback remain unchanged after both clear gestures.
- Verify held-step K1+K2 preserves neighbouring overrides, and repeated clears are idempotent.

The five new cases exercise step clearing, neighbour preservation and channel override clearing ([mask_clearing.py:32](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/tests/behaviour/mask_clearing.py:32)); they do not explicitly establish nonempty-default preservation or second-channel isolation. No acceptance claim follows yet.

**CONFIDENCE: High.** Explicit product intent requiring default reset would change the recommendation; I did not run tests or independently verify the recorded native results.
